mtp_device_stall_diagnostic.note: All five samples retained. The fifth request spent roughly ten minutes stalled in GPU-to-CPU transfer. A one-second external CPU sample was collected during that stall, so this series is diagnostic rather than clean final latency evidence. Sample showed MLX Event::wait via IOSurface; process physical footprint 21.6 GiB and system swap use about 13.7 GiB. This does not establish a code-only cause. Do not recommend allocator-only GPU mode for GenAI MTP based on this run.
